detail.readme:
OSINT-D2

Investigate public identity data with an AI agent that follows leads and documents its evidence.

> [!IMPORTANT] > **Use OSINT-D2 only for lawful, authorized investigations.** It collects and infers information about people. Privacy law can apply even to public data, results can be wrong, and scan results are sent to your AI provider unless you use Ollama. Read [Security & Responsible Use](https://osint-d2.angelcalderon.dev/guides/security/) first. OSINT-D2 is a command-line tool and local web dashboard for security researchers, journalists, and OSINT analysts. Give it a username, email, or phone number, and it checks public sources, separates likely matches from namesakes, and produces a report you can verify. ## What it does | | | |---|---| | **Agent investigations** | An LLM chooses which tools to run, follows new leads such as emails and websites, and writes a report. | | **Direct scans** | 20 username scanners and 4 email scanners, with optional [Sherlock](https://github.com/sherlock-project/sherlock) (about 470 sites) and site lists. No AI needed. | | **False-positive filtering** | Declare accounts you already trust (`--trust github:johndoe`). Other profiles are scored on name, bio, avatar, and location, and contradictions are discarded. | | **Identity correlation** | Compares avatars with perceptual hashing and writing style with character n-grams. | | **Reports** | PDF dossiers, JSON, and graphs for Obsidian Canvas and HTML. | | **Choice of AI provider** | DeepSeek, OpenAI, or any OpenAI-compatible API. Use Ollama to keep inference on your machine. | An agent run looks like this (illustrative, with fictitious data): ```text Target: johndoe scan_username johndoe 3 confirmed of 20 scanned fetch_url example.com/johndoe found john@example.com scan_email john@example.com 2 confirmed generate_report confidence 82% (model estimate) ```

## Quick start Direct scans need no API key. Agent runs and AI analysis need one, unless you use Ollama. ### pipx Requires Python 3.11+ and [pipx](https://pipx.pypa.io/). ```bash pipx install git+https://github.com/Doble-2/osint-d2.git osint-d2 scan johndoe ``` That's enough for scans. Run `osint-d2 doctor run` to see which optional parts are missing, and `osint-d2 serve` to open the dashboard, which offers to install what it needs. ### Docker ```bash curl -fsSLO https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Doble-2/osint-d2/main/scripts/install-docker.sh sh install-docker.sh ``` This creates an `osint-d2` folder with the Compose file, a `.env` for your AI key, and a `reports` folder. Open . To use the CLI, prefix commands with `docker compose exec osint-d2`: ```bash docker compose exec osint-d2 osint-d2 scan johndoe ``` ### Poetry For development. Requires Python 3.11+ and [Poetry](https://python-poetry.org/). The [Pango libraries](https://osint-d2.angelcalderon.dev/getting-started/installation/#system-dependencies) are optional, for CLI PDFs. ```bash git clone https://github.com/Doble-2/osint-d2.git && cd osint-d2 poetry install poetry run playwright install chromium cp .env.example .env # Add your AI key poetry run osint-d2 doctor run poetry run osint-d2 serve ``` ### Prebuilt binaries Download them from [Releases](https://github.com/Doble-2/osint-d2/releases). They aren't signed, so your system may warn you. The [installation guide](https://osint-d2.angelcalderon.dev/getting-started/installation/#standalone-binaries) explains that, and what PDFs need. > [!WARNING] > OSINT-D2 is a local tool: for ethical and legal reasons, the project doesn't operate a hosted version. The dashboard has no authentication by design and listens on localhost. Don't expose it to other people or to the internet. ## Usage ```bash # Scan a username (no AI) osint-d2 scan johndoe # Several targets, with Sherlock osint-d2 hunt -u johndoe,jdoe123 -e john@example.com --sherlock # Add AI analysis and a PDF osint-d2 hunt -u johndoe --ai --export-pdf # Agent investigation, starting from a trusted account osint-d2 agent johndoe --trust github:johndoe --max-steps 10 # Machine-readable output (the default when piping) osint-d2 scan johndoe --format json | jq '.profiles[] | select(.exists)' ``` See the [CLI reference](https://osint-d2.angelcalderon.dev/guides/cli-reference/) for every option. ## Configuration Set a provider and key in `.env`. The endpoint and model come from the provider unless you override them. ```env # DeepSeek (default) OSINT_D2_AI_PROVIDER=deepseek OSINT_D2_AI_API_KEY=sk-xxxxxxxx # OpenAI OSINT_D2_AI_PROVIDER=openai OSINT_D2_AI_API_KEY=sk-xxxxxxxx # Ollama (no key needed) OSINT_D2_AI_PROVIDER=ollama OSINT_D2_AI_MODEL=llama3.1 ``` Inside Docker, Ollama also needs its [container address](https://osint-d2.angelcalderon.dev/guides/docker/#ollama-fully-offline). Optional services: - **Breach checks:** set `OSINT_D2_HIBP_API_KEY` to use the official [Have I Been Pwned API](https://haveibeenpwned.com/API/Key), a paid service. It receives the full email address. - **Proxy:** OSINT-D2 can route scans through ScrapingAnt, a third-party service, using `OSINT_D2_PROXY_API_KEY`. ## Agent tools | Tool | Purpose | |------|---------| | `scan_username` | Check a username across the 20 native scanners | | `scan_email` | Gravatar and PGP keyservers, with an optional username pivot | | `breach_check` | Query the official Have I Been Pwned API (optional) | | `fetch_url` | Extract emails and social links from a page, with SSRF protection | | `compare_avatars` | Compare images with a perceptual hash (dHash) | | `scan_phone` | Carrier, country, line type, and WhatsApp status | | `search_vector_memory` | BM25 keyword search across collected evidence | | `correlate_stylometry` | Compare writing style with character n-grams | | `generate_report` | Finish with the report | The report covers identity, geo-temporal signals, and technical profile. Personality (OCEAN), ideology, and attack-surface sections are off by default; enable them with `--sensitive-inferences`. They are speculative inferences, and the confidence score is the model's own estimate, so verify them before relying on them. ## Documentation - [Installation](https://osint-d2.angelcalderon.dev/getting-started/installation/) and [Quick Start](https://osint-d2.angelcalderon.dev/getting-started/quickstart/) - [Web Dashboard](https://osint-d2.angelcalderon.dev/guides/web-dashboard/) and [Agent Mode](https://osint-d2.angelcalderon.dev/guides/agent-mode/) - [Trust Anchors](https://osint-d2.angelcalderon.dev/architecture/trust-anchors/) and [Architecture](https://osint-d2.angelcalderon.dev/architecture/overview/) - [REST and WebSocket API](https://osint-d2.angelcalderon.dev/api/endpoints/) - [Security & Responsible Use](https://osint-d2.angelcalderon.dev/guides/security/) ## Contributing See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) and the guide to [adding a scanner](https://osint-d2.angelcalderon.dev/contributing/adding-scanners/). ```bash poetry install poetry run pytest poetry run ruff check . ``` ## Disclaimer OSINT-D2 is intended for authorized security research, journalism, and OSINT investigations. You are responsible for complying with the laws that apply to you. The authors assume no liability for misuse. ## License [MIT](LICENSE) © Doble-2
